name: Unuki
source:
A big fox shikigami of the Special Riot Police's second division's officer [url=https://vndb.org/c99110]Kuzunoha Kagura[/url]. He has been close with Kuzunoha [url=https://vndb.org/c99110]Kagura[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c108514]Kaguya[/url] since they were children, and they are like family to him. Unaki has a nervous nature. [url=https://vndb.org/c99110]Kagura[/url], the older sister, makes him worry, much as she does to her younger sister [url=https://vndb.org/c108514]Kaguya[/url]. Frequently, when she makes an unreasonable request, he looks astonished and says: "Eh? Really?!".

Recently, if something happens in the second division, he tends to side with the [url=https://vndb.org/c99112]protagonist[/url] rather than [url=https://vndb.org/c99110]Kagura[/url]. It could be because there have been a lot of ridiculous requests lately. He now takes naps with the officers of the second division, [url=https://vndb.org/c99107]Kotetsu[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c99108]Isana[/url], on a daily basis. In the naps, his role is to stand in for the pillow.

Unaki has the ability to understand people who cannot speak. Due to his smartness and dexterity, he is frequently assigned to missions such as converting acts, gathering intelligence, and rescuing hostages. He is also popular among children; they like to stroke him. He might be considered the second division mascot character.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.propeller-game.com/product/yuzuriha/chara10.html]official site[/url]]
